latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of markdown-linter-cli.

- Lints Markdown files for formatting issues, style consistency, and broken/bad links
- Supports header hierarchy, image alt text, internal/external link validation, line length, trailing whitespace, and more
- Provides configurable CLI options for input files, max line length, rule ignoring, and external link checking
- Outputs detailed linting results and summaries in JSON format
- Includes rule reference for all checks performed
